chunks: We gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion, and a light and reminder for those who take heed for themselves,

key_terms.الْفُرْقَانُ: The Criterion; that which distinguishes truth from falsehood, often referring to the Quran or prophetic authority.
key_terms.ضِيَاءً: Light; illumination that guides the heart and mind.
key_terms.لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ: For the God-conscious; those who possess taqwa and mindfulness of God.

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Al-Furqan given to Moses and Aaron in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'Furqan' bestowed upon Musa and Harun is often interpreted not only as the Torah but also as the broader prophetic authority and the light of Imamate, serving as a precursor to the ultimate guidance of the Ahl al-Bayt. This verse underscores the continuity of divine revelation, where the 'light' (Dhiya') signifies the spiritual illumination granted to the God-conscious (al-muttaqin) to distinguish truth from falsehood. The reference to both prophets together highlights their complementary roles in establishing the foundation of monotheism and judicial authority within the Shia understanding of prophetic succession.
